scope: Bottle-pose motion in the attached-bottle MuJoCo scene.

inputs: Target bottle-mouth position and bottle orientation
request_move.behavior: Plan synchronously from measured position and velocity. Activate an accepted trajectory immediately, replacing any active move. A rejection preserves the active move.

inputs: Current MuJoCo state with refreshed kinematics
update.behavior: Advance the active trajectory and write position servo targets. The caller steps physics.

verification: Reject a path through the cylinder
Preserve the active move after a rejected replacement
Interrupt an active tilt with an upright request
